description.subtitle: Short pants of the first equipment Puma del Girona 2025 2025 - red
description.tagline: A lightweight trousers to play as professionals
description.intro: Complete your Girona equipment with this official Puma short. Made of recycled material and designed to offer total mobility, it is perfect for training or encouraging the team from the stands.
key_benefits: Official Girona design: Inspired by the club's first equipment.
Recycled fabric: Sustainable material without giving up performance.
Total Lightness: Favor fast movement on each play.
Elastic waistband with cord: Comfortable and safe fit during the match.
A striking style: Vibrant red colour that stands out in the field.
